title: Apply a signed score change
user_visible_behavior: The scorekeeper adds positive or negative integer points to one player and sees the total immediately.
verification: Apply +10 then -3 to one player; verify total 7 and other players remain at zero.
Reject decimals, non-numbers, and unsafe amounts without altering totals; test signed input on mobile.
Run CI=true ./init.sh with the real checks established during bootstrap; record exact commands and results.
notes: No mandatory round or zero entries for other players. Resolve safe bounds and zero handling in the spec.

title: Rank the live leaderboard
user_visible_behavior: Players appear in descending total order with equal totals sharing their competition rank.
verification: Verify totals 12, 12, 8 produce ranks 1, 1, 3; verify negative totals and all-player ties.
Change a score and check immediate reorder, stable tied display, and retained keyboard focus.
Run CI=true ./init.sh with the real checks established during bootstrap; record exact commands and results.
notes: Use rank = 1 + count of strictly higher totals. Keep names/icons readable with 20 players.

title: Undo the latest score change
user_visible_behavior: The scorekeeper reverses the latest score change and sees corrected totals and ranks.
verification: Apply changes to two different players; undo the latest and verify only its recipient total is restored.
Check undo when there is no change and after a negative change.
Run CI=true ./init.sh with the real checks established during bootstrap; record exact commands and results.
notes: Resolve repeated-undo depth in the spec. Undo applies to scores, not finishing.

title: Resume a saved game
user_visible_behavior: The homepage lists browser-saved games and reopens an unfinished game with its roster and scores intact.
verification: Create and score two games, reload the browser page, then resume each from home with correct independent totals.
Check saved names, colors, game labels, ordering, and local-only retention messaging on mobile.
Run CI=true ./init.sh with the real checks established during bootstrap; record exact commands and results.
notes: Persist successful game mutations in localStorage. Define saved-data format and undo-after-reload behavior; catch save errors from the start.

title: Explain unavailable game storage
user_visible_behavior: Storage failures and invalid saved data produce actionable feedback without silently losing or overwriting saved games.
verification: Simulate blocked/quota-failing writes; verify no false saved confirmation and no silent loss of prior data.
Load malformed or incompatible saved data; verify an understandable error and preservation of the original payload.
Run CI=true ./init.sh with the real checks established during bootstrap; record exact commands and results.
notes: Keep diagnostics local. No cloud recovery, export, or data-deletion feature; define the safe failure behavior in the spec.

title: Finish a game with locked standings
user_visible_behavior: The scorekeeper confirms finishing; final standings remain saved and read-only when reopened from home.
verification: Cancel finishing and confirm scoring still works; then finish and verify score/undo mutations are unavailable.
Reload and reopen the finished game; verify final ranks and totals remain unchanged.
Run CI=true ./init.sh with the real checks established during bootstrap; record exact commands and results.
notes: Finalization is irreversible in the MVP. Keep the complete standings available; celebratory modal is the next slice.

user_visible_behavior: Finishing opens a dismissible podium modal with all players in ranks 1–3 and brief confetti.
verification: Finish tied games including ranks 1, 1, 3 and all 20 players tied; ensure all eligible players are visible.
